```{r} 

sites <- get_wq_sites()

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  sf::st_bbox() %>%
  sf::st_as_sfc() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(1000)

land_barrier <- sf::st_difference(
  study_extent,
  sf::st_union(study_area)
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf()

cost_raster <- ipdw::costrasterGen(
  xymat = sites,
  pols = land_barrier,
  extent = "polys",
  projstr = sf::st_crs(study_area)$proj4string,
  resolution = 100
)


dp <- c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0)
mr <- c(5000, 7500, 10000, 12500, 15000)

```

**Salinity**

Test model sensitivity for distance powers
```{r}
# SAL

sal_test <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  sal_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "ppt",
  dist_powers = dp
)

# save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  sal_test$summary,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "salinity_dp_test.rds")
)

```


Test model for max range sensitivity

```{r}

sal_mr_test <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  sal_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "ppt",
  dist_powers = 2,
  max_ranges = mr
)

saveRDS(
  sal_mr_test,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "salinity_mr_test.rds")
)
```

```{r}

# run model using tuned parameters
set.seed(42)
sal_ipdw <- ipdw_manual(sal_clean, cost_raster, 12500, "mean", dist_power = 2)
```
